title: Digi International Announces Digi EX61 for Rugged, Indoor/Outdoor 5G Branch Connectivity
summary: New 5G cellular extender delivers primary 5G or automatic failover, with dual-SIM backup that fails over cell-to-cell up to 10X faster, to locations a conventional router cannot reach
